resolution_notes: Both verifiers correctly flag the homepage as docs and the placeholder example; official web-services page confirms free unauthenticated REST access, soft rate guidance without numeric quotas, and SPL endpoints. free_tier_limits: Free public API (no auth); no published numeric free-tier quota. Rate limiting may apply under high load; avoid parallel requests and paginate large result sets (page/pagesize).
rate_limits: No public numeric quota. Official guidance: do not send simultaneous/parallel requests; use sequential requests and pagination for large queries; rate limiting may apply under high load.
